app.storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Changes may not persist.

welcome.eyebrow: Your flight history, in your hands
welcome.title: The data outlives the app.
welcome.description: Create your own archive and add flights with a simple form. No JSON file is required. Your data stays in this browser.
welcome.privacy: Local by design. Nothing is uploaded.

demo.label: Demo archive
demo.description: You are exploring fictional sample flights. This is not your personal history.
demo.exportConfirmation: This is fictional demo data. Export it anyway?

flights.emptyDescription: Use the guided form to start your archive. Keepraw Fly handles the JSON format for you.

flightEditor.airlineCodeHint: Choose a suggestion or enter an unlisted 2-character IATA or 3-letter ICAO code.
flightEditor.serviceNumberHint: Enter the digits and optional suffix only, or paste a complete number such as MU589.
flightEditor.fullFlightNumber: The complete flight number will be saved as {{number}}
flightEditor.localTimeNote: Enter each time as shown locally at its airport. Timezone offsets are added automatically.
flightEditor.optionalFactsDescription: Actual times, airport details, aircraft and seat
flightEditor.sameAirport: Origin and destination must be different airports.
flightEditor.arrivalBeforeDeparture: Arrival must be later than departure after timezone conversion.
flightEditor.actualArrivalBeforeDeparture: Actual arrival must be later than actual departure.
flightEditor.incompleteActualTime: Enter both the date and time for each actual event.
flightEditor.invalidAirlineCode: Enter a 2-character IATA or 3-letter ICAO airline code.
flightEditor.invalidServiceNumber: Enter 1 to 4 digits with an optional letter suffix.
flightEditor.invalidFlight: Please check the flight details and try again.
flightEditor.deleteConfirmation: Delete this flight from your archive?

passport.mapDescription: Route geometry is derived locally from airport reference data.
passport.mapPreviewLabel: World map showing {{flights}} flights between recorded airports
passport.mapLegend: Airport labels mark the most visited points. Thicker routes represent repeated flights.

import.replaceWarningTitle: This will replace the current archive
import.replaceWarning: Once confirmed, the existing {{flights}} flights in this browser will be replaced by the imported file. Export a backup first if you need to keep them.

settings.description: Display preferences stay local. Profile names travel with your Keepraw Fly archive.
settings.importDescription: Validate and preview a Keepraw Fly JSON file. The current archive changes only after confirmation.
settings.exportDescription: Download a complete, validated and portable copy of your facts.
settings.exportDescriptionDemo: This archive contains fictional demo flights. Export only if you need the sample file.
settings.clearDescription: Remove this flight archive from the current browser.
settings.clearConfirmation: Clear the local Keepraw Fly archive? Export first if you need a backup.
settings.powerUserDescription: Enable only if you understand the Keepraw Fly data model.
settings.advancedPlaceholder: Advanced editing is reserved for a future release. No raw editor is enabled yet.
